Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters necessary for procedures for lawsuits seeking prohibition or cessation of acts filed pursuant to Article 70 of the Framework Act on Consumers (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") (hereinafter referred to as "consumer organization lawsuits").
